description: Implement WebSocket for real-time updates (participant count, match scores, leaderboard ranks). Add polling fallback if WebSocket unavailable. Implement heartbeat, auto-reconnect, error handling.
steps: Create app/api/ws/route.js: WebSocket endpoint that accepts connections, verifies auth token (optional), broadcasts match updates, participant count changes, leaderboard updates to all subscribers
Create lib/flowternity/websocket.js: useWebSocket hook that connects to ws://[domain]/ws/games on mount
Implement heartbeat: server sends ping every 30s, client responds pong, client closes if no ping for 90s
Queue local updates during disconnect, sync on reconnect via API fetch
Subscribe to channels: game:all, tournament:[id], leaderboard:[sport_id]
Broadcast message types: game:participant_joined, game:participant_left, match:score_updated, leaderboard:updated, announcement:new
Implement polling fallback: if WebSocket unavailable (timeout after 5s), poll /api/games, /api/tournaments/:id/bracket, /api/leaderboards/:sport_id every 30s-60s via React Query refetchInterval
UI indicator: show 'Reconnecting...' toast when offline, 'Connected' when online
Integrate into app/games/page.js: call useWebSocket on mount, update component state on message receive
acceptance_criteria: WebSocket connects on page load (verify in DevTools Network tab)
Participant count updates in real-time when user joins (< 1s latency)
Match score broadcast updates bracket in real-time
Auto-reconnect works: close connection, verify reconnect after 1s
Polling fallback activates when WebSocket unavailable
Message queue and sync works: queue message while offline, sync on reconnect
Error handling: malformed message, auth failure logged
verification: Run yarn dev, open /games in browser, open DevTools Network > WS
Watch ping frames every 30s in Network tab
Open game in another window/tab, join it, verify participant count updates in real-time in first tab (< 1s)
Post match score via API, verify bracket updates in real-time on subscribed clients
Disable network (offline mode), verify 'Reconnecting...' toast, enable network, verify 'Connected' toast
Close DevTools, open Network, filter to WS, verify reconnect frames on disconnect/reconnect
Stop WebSocket server (if possible) or timeout connection, verify polling fallback activates (check XHR requests every 30s)
